definitions.gloss: bedside; the area by one's pillow
definitions.explanation: The space right beside the head of a sleeping person, near the pillow. The spot where one keeps things to reach while lying down or where someone sits to attend to a sleeper.

examples.english: To put water by the bedside.

examples.japanese: ⟦{目覚|めざ}まし{時計|どけい}→目覚まし時計：03159_mezamashidokei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{枕元|まくらもと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}いて→置く：01092_oku⟧⟦{寝|ね}た→寝る：00470_neru⟧。
examples.english: I put the alarm clock by my pillow and went to sleep.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{枕元|まくらもと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一晩中|ひとばんじゅう}→一晩中：20338_hitobanjuu⟧⟦{付|つ}き{添|そ}っていた→付き添う：10585_tsukisou⟧。
examples.english: My mother stayed at the sick child's bedside all night long.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{枕|まくら}→枕：03898_makura⟧ (pillow) + ⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧ (the area near). Refers specifically to the space by the head of someone lying down, as opposed to the foot of the bed (⟦{足元|あしもと}→足元：04096_ashimoto⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {枕元|まくらもと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧: place at the bedside
- {枕元|まくらもと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: stand at the bedside (often of a figure in a dream)
- {枕元|まくらもと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{付|つ}き{添|そ}う→付き添う：10585_tsukisou⟧: attend at someone's bedside
